name: sonecheck
description: Sub-second System-1 AI code risk inspector for VS Code and Git hooks. Local MVP: scores your staged diff and surfaces the few hunks worth a human look.

sonecheck.riskThreshold.description: Risk score at or above which a hunk is listed for manual review (exclusive bounds 0 and 1).

sonecheck.maxItems.description: Maximum number of risky hunks shown in the pick list (Top-K).

sonecheck.enabled.description: Global switch for the SoneCheck inspection.

sonecheck.sensitivePathPatterns.description: Path substrings treated as sensitive; a match counts as an auth-boundary risk.

scripts.test:integration: node -e "console.log('T2 contract tests land in S2/S6 (400-build 3.7)')"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
